notes: No more "DuckAI is ready" notification. Say "Hey Duck" and DuckAI answers. DuckAI hears German and other languages much better, answers in the language it writes in, speaks while it writes, and listening no longer fails (errors 8 and 11). DuckOS's own Settings everywhere: apps, privacy, location, languages, date and time, accessibility, accounts, default apps, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and hotspot. Settings stays open when you change the theme or text size. Light theme: DuckTask, DuckPay, DuckWallet's icon, recent apps and the DuckAI bar are light too. Each DuckOS app has its own icon in recent apps. DuckStore offers DuckTask's apps. Fast typing isn't taken for swiping any more. Delete all DuckAI chats at once. Back on the home screen does nothing.
